title: Aflac Happy Ghasts
description: This Pack simply Makes the Happy Ghast's Ambient Noise Scream "AFLAC!"
body: For Minecraft 1.21.0, this pack turns Happy Ghasts into chaotic Aflac mascots that scream goofy duck facts across the Nether, blending humor with loud quacks to brighten every encounter everywhere!!!! official downloads are here on modrinth or my discord server :)
